nodes.description: Contract owner address, set in constructor from msg.sender and used in whenOwner modifier and as transfer/selfdestruct recipient.
Mapping of player address to pending withdrawal balance; credited in userRegister and zeroed before transfer in userWithdraw.
Current round counter, initialized to 1, incremented at end of userRegister and used as index into participants.
Mapping of round index to a fixed 3-address array storing the previous, current and winning participant.
Constructor; sets owner = msg.sender, round = 1 and participants[1][0] = owner.
Owner-only external function that transfers an arbitrary amount of contract balance to owner.
Owner-only external function that destroys the contract and sends remaining balance to owner.
Public view returning the current round value.
Public view returning participants at a caller-supplied index.
Public view returning the pending withdrawal balance of a caller-supplied player address.
Withdraws the caller's pending balance: requires balance > 0, zeroes the balance, then transfers it to msg.sender.
Payable registration: requires 105 finney, stores msg.sender into participants, picks a pseudo-random winner using blockhash, credits 100 finney to the winner's withdrawals and advances the round.
Modifier function requiring msg.sender == owner; gates ownerWithdraw and ownerDestroy.
msg.sender - attacker-controlled caller address used for authorization, registration, balance lookup and as transfer recipient.
owner.transfer(amount) in ownerWithdraw: external ETH transfer of an unbounded amount to the owner.
selfdestruct(owner) in ownerDestroy: terminates the contract and forwards all balance to owner.
msg.sender.transfer(amount) in userWithdraw: external ETH transfer to an untrusted address, executed after state write (reentrancy-relevant sink).
uint(blockhash(block.number - 1)) used as a pseudo-random source in userRegister: miner-influenceable/weak randomness determining the reward winner.
withdrawals[participants[round][x]] += reward in userRegister: unchecked arithmetic credit to a storage mapping.
round++ in userRegister: unchecked arithmetic increment of the round counter used as array index.
Parameter amount of ownerWithdraw, forwarded directly into owner.transfer.
Parameter index of publicGetParticipants, used to read participants[index].
Parameter player of publicGetBalance, used to read withdrawals[player].
Local variable amount in userWithdraw holding the cached withdrawals[msg.sender] value passed to transfer.
Local variable reward in userRegister, fixed at 100 finney and credited to the winner's withdrawals.
Local variable random in userRegister, derived from blockhash and participant addresses and used in the modulo branch condition.

edges.reason: constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender as the privileged owner address.
whenOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner to decide authorization.
whenOwner modifier gates execution of ownerWithdraw.
whenOwner modifier gates execution of ownerDestroy.
ownerWithdraw forwards its amount parameter into owner.transfer.
owner.transfer sends an arbitrary amount of contract balance to the owner address.
ownerWithdraw executes the external transfer operation.
ownerDestroy executes selfdestruct.
selfdestruct(owner) forwards the whole contract balance to the owner address.
publicGetRound reads the round state variable.
publicGetParticipants reads the participants mapping.
publicGetParticipants uses its index parameter to index participants.
publicGetBalance reads the withdrawals mapping.
publicGetBalance uses its player parameter to index withdrawals.
userWithdraw executes msg.sender.transfer after zeroing the balance.
local amount is passed as the value of msg.sender.transfer.
transfer to msg.sender hands control to an untrusted address that can re-enter userWithdraw or other functions.
userWithdraw writes withdrawals[msg.sender] = 0 before the external transfer.
userWithdraw reads the pending balance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
userRegister executes the reward credit to withdrawals.
local reward is added to a storage balance without overflow/underflow checks (Solidity 0.4.22).
unchecked arithmetic writes the credited amount into the withdrawals mapping.
userRegister executes the round increment after distributing the reward.
unchecked round++ updates the round counter that is reused as a mapping/index key.
blockhash-based pseudo-randomness produces the local random value used for the modulo branch.
the random modulo condition decides which participant receives the reward credit.
userRegister stores the untrusted msg.sender into participants[round][1]/[round][0] and reads participants back.
userRegister executes the blockhash-based randomness computation.
the untrusted msg.sender invokes the payable userRegister entry point.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the ownerWithdraw transfer and has no independent semantic role.
The index parameter is only consumed by the publicGetParticipants view accessor.
The player parameter is only consumed by the publicGetBalance view accessor.
The amount local is a transient cache of withdrawals[msg.sender] used solely inside userWithdraw.
The reward local is a constant 100 finney value that exists only to be added into the withdrawals mapping.
The random local is derived from blockhash and participant addresses only to select the reward winner, so it folds into the weak-randomness operation.
